notes: Most g11 labels were per-function guesses: List/Table/Names/Sub/Game are grab-bags. Functions were moved to the class of the object they run on (evidence: gamefil2.cpp subsystem save tables {global, function}, the global passed as `this` (as_X(obj(d::g_...))), callers passing `this`, and matching offsets). New classes: ListBox/ListBoxColumn/ListBoxItem (interfac/list.cpp), MgList, DropItem, GrassType, GrassPatch, HelpEntry, ProfileEntry, LogMessage, NewsList, CamGroupSet, LodEntry. Labels dissolved into other classes: Steer, Grass, Tooltip, Door, Order19, IdList, StrPool, StrTable, Sub, Campaign, Gfile3Rec, SlotOwner, ShortSet, ShortList, WordList. Cross-group: the main-loop object g_game_a50088 (label Game: run/draw/tick/set_speed/set_state/on_mode, Mode::set_499540, Sub::load_44, GameFile::write_header_476c40, ctor 0x4d6b90) is g06's Wnd; it needs 0x22 frame_count, 0x26 tick_count, 0x2a real_time, 0x2e frame_ms, 0x32 game_time (u32), 0x36 game_dt i32, 0x3a mode i8, 0x3b prev_mode u8, 0x3c next_mode i8, 0x40 frame_scale f32, 0x44 speed f32, 0x151 u8; its base SysEnWindow gets 0x6035c0 (ctor), 0x603710 (open: +0x15/+0x18 bytes, vtable slot 0x18) and init_display 0x6037f0 (Dev +4/+8). Player (g12) receives rts/update_mode functions whose fields go up to 0x1269; Gate/Wall (base Unit) need a map-object base split out of Unit (g09) to state their 0xdb size; UnitList (g12) receives List::save_4838e0 (+0x2e word, profile list g_a47ca8). Unassigned: 0x484d50 (resets a 0xe4-byte record loaded by 0x484d00; owner unknown).
